snippet.title: Banana of Doom - Official Trailer | Wishlist on Steam Now!
snippet.description:
You can wishlist Banana of Doom, a wacky party deckbuilding game, on Steam RIGHT NOW!
Dive into this party style deck building and card crafting game where you'll combine words in your hand to win tournaments.

I directed and developed this game with the fine people at Little Umbrella. It's a very silly, very yellow, very funky, high potassium experience. I hope you wishlist it and look forward to the Steam release :) -Rob

Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3898830/Banana_of_Doom?utm_campaign=wishlist_push&utm_source=robchannel&utm_medium=youtube

In Banana of Doom you'll
- Collect cards to build your ultimate party deck
- Compete with friends online in chaotic tournaments
- Be the top banana in this fast-paced multiplayer card game

If you're a fan of Jackbox or Exploding Kittens, love chaotic indie games, or just want to try something new with your friends, Banana of Doom delivers.

Release Date: TBD
Platform: Steam (PC, Steamdeck)
Developer: Playroom
Publisher: Little Umbrella

Join the Discord for updates, behind the scenes with the devs, and community events: discord.gg/playroom

Banana of Doom is coming soon to Steam — a hilarious party game that mixes deckbuilding, card crafting, and chaotic multiplayer fun. Wishlist today and join the party!
